description: This file defines functions for generating and updating block IDs within a tree structure, including handling references and maintaining consistency of IDs across blocks in a project related to Focalboard.

methods.name: GenerateBlockIDs
methods.description: Generates new IDs for a list of blocks, updating references to maintain the tree structure.

methods.name: fixFieldIDs
methods.description: Updates IDs within a specific field of a block, handling nested structures.
